title: Derivative Type Mapping Theorem for the Interpolative Berinde Weak Contraction in Metric Spaces with Application
summary: Olatinwo [3] introduced contractive definitions of the derivative type, and gave a new characterization of the Banach contraction principle, and fixed point theorems for contractions defined implicitly. On the other hand Ampadu et.al [4] introduced derivative type contractions in the setting of multiplicative metric spaces. In this paper, we have obtained a fixed point theorem of the derivative type for interpolative Berinde weak contractive mappings [2] in the setting of metric spaces.
